sections.heading: Product name and transition
paragraphs: The current official FAQ calls Devin Desktop the new name for Windsurf. It says the IDE remains available and plans, pricing, extensions, settings and in-progress work carry over with the standard over-the-air update. This record has not tested an individual account transition.

sections.heading: Keep price and account scope separate
paragraphs: The vendor describes continuity for an existing account, but this record does not capture a current checkout amount or verify account-specific entitlements. Confirm the plan and usage terms before budgeting or changing a working environment.

faqs.question: Is Devin Desktop the new name for Windsurf?
faqs.answer: Yes. The official FAQ describes Devin Desktop as the new name for Windsurf and says the full IDE remains accessible.

faqs.question: What does the vendor say carries over during the standard update?
faqs.answer: The FAQ says plans, pricing, extensions, settings and in-progress work carry over with the over-the-air update. Confirm the applicable path and quote for the specific account.

verdict: Treat Devin Desktop as the documented continuation of Windsurf; confirm the account-specific update path and current plan terms before acting.
